text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning; when did you first notice the vomiting and has it been every time they eat? I need to know if there is any blood or stool in the vomit and if the baby has passed any stool since birth.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Brother had pyloric stenosis. Social history: NA

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Malrotation with Volvulus

Based on the history of bilious vomiting starting in the first day of life, the presence of a brother with pyloric stenosis, and the ultrasound showing a "whirlpool sign," the clinical picture strongly suggests this diagnosis. I am ready to proceed with surgical consultation immediately.
